name: Baker's Cay Resort
positioning: Baker's Cay Resort Key Largo, Curio Collection by Hilton: a whitewashed, modern beach resort on 13 acres of private bayfront in the Florida Keys
best_for: Couples and families who want beach time and water sports in the Keys

facts.text: The resort sits on 13 acres of private bayfront on the island of Key Largo in the Florida Keys.
The resort is a member of Hilton's Curio Collection.
The resort is whitewashed and modern, with tall ceilings and walls of windows.
Rooms feature hardwood floors, patterns with coastal elements and sleek, modern bathrooms.
The resort has two waterfall pools and beach hammocks.
Water activities offered include diving, parasailing, catamaran sailing and deep-sea fishing.
The daily resort charge includes bicycles, beach chairs and umbrellas, paddle boards and kayaks, fishing rods with bait, family activities and a daily sunset toast.
The indoor-outdoor Calusa serves breakfast and dinner with a Caribbean-Creole slant.
Dining includes Creole-Caribbean cuisine with panoramic Florida Bay views and beachside dishes with live music at the cove bar.
The resort is pet-friendly, with a 35-pound maximum weight.
John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park is 6 miles away.

highlights.text: There are two beaches: Hammock Beach, which tends to be quiet, and a more active beach for watersports such as kayaking and paddleboarding.
A hook-and-cook program lets guests bring their catch from a fishing excursion to the kitchen.
The resort has a director of pet relations.
The resort won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards every year from 2019 through 2026.

considerations.text: Miami International Airport is 64 miles away and there is no airport shuttle.
A daily resort charge of $49 applies per night.
Key Largo's main drag can be touristy; the resort is a chic departure from that.
